items.headline: Flood Advisory issued November 19 at 12:47PM PST until November 19 at 1:45PM PST by NWS San Diego CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Urban area and small stream flooding caused by excessive
rainfall continues.

* WHERE...Northwestern San Diego County in southwestern California...

* WHEN...Until 145 PM PST.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Ponding of water in urban or other areas is occurring or is
imminent.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1246 PM PST, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated
heavy rain. This  will cause urban and small stream flooding.
- Additional rainfall amounts of 0.25 to 0.5 inches are expected
over the area. This additional rain will result in minor
flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Oceanside, Carlsbad, Vista, San Clemente, Camp Pendleton,
Fallbrook, Dana Point and Rancho Santa Margarita.
- https://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
items.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

items.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued November 19 at 1:33AM PST until November 20 at 9:00AM PST by NWS San Diego CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Surf of 3 to 5 feet. Sets to 7 feet along west-facing
beaches.

* WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas and Orange County
Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...From 6 AM PST today through Friday morning.

* IMPACTS...Increased risk for rip currents. Areas of coastal
flooding possible during high tide each morning along
boardwalks and parking lots.
items.instruction:
A beach hazards statement is issued when threats such as rip
currents and other hazards are possible. Caution should be used
when in or near the water.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 19 at 2:05AM PST until November 20 at 10:00AM PST by NWS San Diego CA
items.description:
* WHAT...West winds 10 to 20 kt with gusts up to 30 kt and seas
5 to 8 ft expected.

* WHERE...Coastal Waters from San Mateo Point to the Mexican
Border and out to 10 nm and Waters from San Mateo Point to the
Mexican Border Extending 10 to 60 nm out including San
Clemente Island.

* WHEN...Through 10 AM PST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
